en.headline: deTour 2026 design festival continues at PMQ with free entry until 29 November
en.dek: Organised by PMQ, the festival features 14 installations under the theme Better, Not Perfect and a new pop-up shop at the Central venue.
body: The deTour 2026 Design Festival is running at PMQ in Central until 29 November, with free admission, the organiser said.

Themed “BETTER, NOT PERFECT: Prototypes for Tomorrow”, the event presents 14 works by creators from Hong Kong, the Chinese mainland and overseas across three exhibition zones in the courtyard and marketplace.

For the first time this year the festival includes an on-site pop-up shop selling limited-edition products, lifestyle items and merchandise by local and international designers. Opening hours are 11 am to 8 pm daily.
The Cultural and Creative Industries Development Agency under the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau is the lead sponsor, and PMQ is the organiser.

zh.headline: deTour 2026設計節在中環PMQ元創方舉行至29日免費入場
zh.dek: 由PMQ主辦，以「不完美，更美好」為主題，設有14件裝置及首次快閃店。
body: deTour 2026設計節正在中環PMQ元創方舉行，至11月29日結束，入場免費，主辦方表示。
今屆以「BETTER, NOT PERFECT 不完美，更美好：Prototypes for Tomorrow」為主題，在庭院及市集展出14件來自香港、內地及海外創作者的作品，分三大展區。
今屆首次設立現場快閃店，售賣本地及國際設計師的限量產品、生活用品及設計節周邊商品。每日開放時間為上午11時至晚上8時。
文化體育及旅遊局轄下文創產業發展處為主要贊助機構，PMQ為主辦單位。
